messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['For the protection of your account we have suspended access to it.', 'Your Account has 1 New Alert, received on April 23, 2013, 8:30.', 'You have an incoming payment slated for your account.', 'During our routine check we noticed a log of invalid login attempts on your card service.', 'Your Online Banking Access has been compromised!', 'Your Nationwide account has been accessed from an unauthorized location.', 'We detect irregular activity on your NatWest Internet banking account on 29/03/2011.', 'I have marked your Request as closed.', 'You have 1 new IMPORTANT message waiting in your inbox folder.', 'In order to make your online banking experience even more secure we, have introduced a new security feature that allows us to detect unusual...', 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', "As part of our ongoing transformation of the online site, we've changed the way your sign-in page looks.", 'We are unable to process your tax return', 'Our Legal Agreements are changing.', 'We would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out scheduled maintenance.', 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', 'We are running a scheduled maintenance on our servers.', 'Someone wit hip address: 137.214.0.17 tried to access your account online.', 'In my department, we discovered an abandoned sum of US$17,500,000.00(Seventeen Million, Five Hundred Thousand United States Dollars only) in an account that belonged to one of our foreign customers who died along with his entire family', 'In the last Food weeks, our Online Banking Security team has observed multiple logon attempts on your Wells Fargo Online account.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
